purpose: Read distinct Single League competition dimensions after normalization for Nexus mapping population
sql: SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM (SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW001_IMC Results` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW004_IMC Results` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW004_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW005_IMC Results` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW005_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW006_IMC Results` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW006_IMC Match Report` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW009_IMC Results` UNION SELECT game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division FROM `GW009_IMC Match Report`) x WHERE competition_key IS NOT NULL AND competition_key<>'' GROUP BY game_world_id,competition_key,competition_group,sm_action,sm_division ORDER BY game_world_id,competition_key
